sections.title: Introduction
sections.html:
Introduction

This manuscript documents the complete Sunday Creative Studio Pro project from the beginning. It is written so you can rebuild the full website without asking for help. The goal is to practice nearly every feature a client may ask for: public pages, forms, login, admin dashboards, ecommerce, payments, emails, image uploads, coupons, reviews, inventory, deployment, and database security.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.html:
Project Overview

The project begins as a business website and grows into a full-stack ecommerce and service platform. The frontend lives in the public folder. The backend uses Express. Supabase handles authentication, database tables, storage, and row-level security. Stripe handles checkout. Resend sends contact and booking emails.

sections.title: Chapter 1 - Build the Frontend
sections.html:
Chapter 1 - Build the Frontend

Create public/index.html. This file contains the entire visible website: header, hero, services, store, cart, checkout, forms, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin sections, and modals. Labels are included for accessibility.

Chapter 2 - Add Styling

Create public/styles.css. The CSS controls responsive layout, cards, grids, modals, admin tables, dark mode, buttons, product images, and mobile behavior.

sections.title: Chapter 3 - Add JavaScript Features
sections.html:
Chapter 3 - Add JavaScript Features

Create public/script.js. This file connects all browser features: Supabase Auth, product loading, cart, favorites, recently viewed, reviews, coupons, order history, admin tabs, image uploads, and frontend form logic.

Chapter 4 - Supabase Database and Auth

Create a Supabase project named sunday-creative-studio-pro. Create tables for products, orders, coupons, and reviews. Enable Email Auth. Add your Supabase Project URL and anon public key inside public/supabase.js.

sections.title: Chapter 5 - Product Images and Storage
sections.html:
Chapter 5 - Product Images and Storage

Create a public Supabase Storage bucket named product-images. Add image_url to products. Upload images through the admin product form. Show those images on store cards and admin tables.

Chapter 6 - Stripe Checkout

Create server.js. The backend creates a Stripe Checkout Session using your secret key. The frontend calls /create-checkout-session. The success page saves the order and reduces stock.

sections.title: Chapter 7 - Resend Email Notifications
sections.html:
Chapter 7 - Resend Email Notifications

Add RESEND_API_KEY to .env. The backend exposes /send-contact and /send-booking. The frontend sends form data to these routes. Emails are sent using onboarding@resend.dev or your verified sending domain.

Chapter 8 - Ecommerce Enhancements

Add coupons, shipping/tax preview, favorites, recently viewed products, product details modal, product reviews, and customer order history.

sections.title: Chapter 9 - Admin Dashboard Features
sections.html:
Chapter 9 - Admin Dashboard Features

Add admin tabs, product management, order status updates, coupon management, review moderation, analytics, customer list, invoices, product editing, and low stock alerts.

Chapter 10 - Deployment Setup

Move static files into public. Keep server.js at the root. Add .env to .gitignore. Add environment variables in Vercel. Update Supabase redirect URLs with your Vercel domain.

Appendix A - SQL Setup

Run these SQL blocks in Supabase SQL Editor. If a policy already exists, drop it first or skip the duplicate.

Database Tables

-- PRODUCTS

create table if not exists products (

id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,

created_at timestamptz default now(),

name text,

price numeric,

category text,

image_url text,

stock bigint default 10

);

-- ORDERS

create table if not exists orders (

id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,

created_at timestamptz default now(),

customer_name text,

customer_email text,

total numeric,

payment_method text,

status text default 'New',

shipping numeric default 0,

tax numeric default 0,

shipping_method text

);

-- COUPONS

create table if not exists coupons (

id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,

created_at timestamptz default now(),

code text,

type text,

value numeric,

minimum numeric default 0,

active boolean default true,

expires_at timestamp

);

-- REVIEWS

create table if not exists reviews (

id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,

created_at timestamptz default now(),

product_id bigint,

customer_name text,

customer_email text,

rating bigint,

comment text

);

-- STORAGE BUCKET

server.js

import express from "express";

import Stripe from "stripe";

import cors from "cors";

import dotenv from "dotenv";

import { Resend } from "resend";

dotenv.config();

const app = express();

const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY);

const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY);

app.use(cors());

app.use(express.json());

app.use(express.static("public"));

app.get("/", (req, res) => {

res.sendFile(process.cwd() + "/public/index.html");

});

function getBaseUrl(req) {

return `${req.protocol}://${req.get("host")}`;

}

app.post("/create-checkout-session", async (req, res) => {

try {

const { cart, coupon } = req.body;

let total = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.price), 0);

if (coupon?.type === "percent") {

total = total - total * (Number(coupon.value) / 100);

}

if (coupon?.type === "fixed") {

total = total - Number(coupon.value);

}

total = Math.max(total, 0);

const baseUrl = getBaseUrl(req);

const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({

payment_method_types: ["card"],

mode: "payment",

line_items: [

{

price_data: {

currency: "usd",

product_data: {

name: coupon ? `Order with Coupon ${coupon.code}` : "Order Total"

},

unit_amount: Math.round(total * 100)

},

quantity: 1

}

],

success_url: `${baseUrl}/success.html`,

cancel_url: `${baseUrl}/cancel.html`

});

res.json({ url: session.url });

} catch (error) {

res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });

}

});

app.post("/send-contact", async (req, res) => {

try {

const { name, email, message } = req.body;

await resend.emails.send({

from: "Sunday Creative Studio <onboarding@resend.dev>",

to: "YOUR_VERIFIED_RESEND_EMAIL@gmail.com",

subject: "New Contact Form Message",

html: `

<h2>New Contact Message</h2>

<p><strong>Name:</strong> ${name}</p>

<p><strong>Email:</strong> ${email}</p>

<p><strong>Message:</strong> ${message}</p>

`

});

res.json({ success: true });

} catch (error) {

res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });

}

});

app.post("/send-booking", async (req, res) => {

try {

const { name, email, phone, service, date, time, message } = req.body;

await resend.emails.send({

from: "Sunday Creative Studio <onboarding@resend.dev>",

to: "YOUR_VERIFIED_RESEND_EMAIL@gmail.com",

subject: "New Booking Request",

html: `

<h2>New Booking Request</h2>

<p><strong>Name:</strong> ${name}</p>

<p><strong>Email:</strong> ${email}</p>

<p><strong>Phone:</strong> ${phone}</p>

<p><strong>Service:</strong> ${service}</p>

<p><strong>Date:</strong> ${date}</p>

<p><strong>Time:</strong> ${time}</p>

<p><strong>Message:</strong> ${message}</p>

`

});

res.json({ success: true });

} catch (error) {

res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });

}

});

if (!process.env.VERCEL) {

app.listen(5500, () => {

console.log("Local server running at http://localhost:5500");

});

}

export default app;

import { supabase } from "./supabase.js";

const pendingOrder = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("pendingOrder"));

async function reduceStock(cart) {

for (const item of cart) {

const currentStock = Number(item.stock || 0);

const newStock = Math.max(currentStock - 1, 0);

const { error } = await supabase

.from("products")

.update({ stock: newStock })

.eq("id", item.id);

if (error) {

console.log("Stock update error:", error.message);

}

}

}

async function savePaidOrder() {

const successMessage = document.getElementById("successMessage");

if (!pendingOrder) {

successMessage.textContent = "Payment completed, but no pending order was found.";

return;

}

const newOrder = {

customer_name: pendingOrder.customerName,

customer_email: pendingOrder.customerEmail,

total: pendingOrder.total,

payment_method: "Stripe Card",

status: "New",

shipping: pendingOrder.shipping || 0,

tax: pendingOrder.tax || 0,

shipping_method: pendingOrder.shippingMethod || "standard"

};

const { error } = await supabase.from("orders").insert([newOrder]);

if (error) {

successMessage.textContent = "Payment succeeded, but order was not saved: " + error.message;

return;

}

await reduceStock(pendingOrder.cart || []);

localStorage.removeItem("pendingOrder");

localStorage.removeItem("cart");

successMessage.textContent = "Payment successful. Order saved and inventory updated.";

}

savePaidOrder();

Appendix C - Troubleshooting Checklist

Website shows plain text

CSS is not loading. Confirm styles.css is in public and index.html links to styles.css.

Cannot GET /

Server is not serving the correct folder. For local testing, run node server.js and open http://localhost:5500.

Stripe test card declined

You are likely using live mode or an old checkout session. Use an sk_test key, restart the server, and create a brand-new checkout session.

Supabase RLS error

Add the correct insert/update/delete policy for the table and role.

Image upload fails

Check that the bucket is named product-images, public, and has storage policies.

Email failed

Check RESEND_API_KEY and make sure the receiving email is verified if you are using Resend test mode.

Login does not work

Check Supabase Auth provider and redirect URLs. Use the same localhost or deployed URL consistently.

Admin section not visible

You must be logged in. The app hides admin sections until Supabase Auth confirms a session.
